_comment: Bannerlord Coop dedicated server. The image ships no game files: steamcmd fetches workshop item 3770450698 into the server volume at boot, so each operator downloads their own entitled copy. Requires a Steam account that owns Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord (app 261550) - anonymous workshop downloads are refused for paid apps. Allocate two consecutive UDP ports: clients join on the primary and the mod also uses primary+1.
name: Bannerlord Coop
author: geoffrey.migliacci@gmail.com
description: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord cooperative campaign server, running the Windows dedicated server build under Wine. Saves, configs and dated backups live in the server volume.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The game files are downloaded by the container at boot, not here: the workshop item
# needs a Steam login, and install containers cannot answer a Steam Guard prompt.
# This only lays out the directories start.sh expects.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/.steamcmd
echo "Directories ready."
echo "On first start, set STEAM_USERNAME (and leave STEAM_PASSWORD empty) and use the"
echo "console to answer the Steam Guard prompt. The first download is about 6 GB."

variables.name: Steam username
variables.description: A Steam account that owns Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord. Required - the workshop item cannot be downloaded anonymously.

variables.name: Steam password
variables.description: Set this and start the server, then approve the login on your phone when Steam prompts you (accounts on emailed codes get a code prompt in the console instead). steamcmd caches a refresh token in the server volume afterwards, good for months, so later starts are unattended. Left empty, the password is prompted for in the console too.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Check Steam for a newer build of the mod on every start. 0 skips Steam entirely and uses the files already present.

variables.name: Extra workshop mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop item IDs to load beside the Coop mod, comma separated. Each mod must ship a Win64_Shipping_Server build, every player needs the same mods at the same versions or their join is refused, and mods that need Bannerlord.Harmony do not work yet. They are loaded after the Coop module, in the order listed.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: World to host, from Game Saves in the data directory. A missing save is created from default_new_game.sav.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Password joining players are prompted for. Empty means open.

variables.name: Autosave minutes
variables.description: Minutes between world autosaves. 0 disables autosaving.

variables.name: Player count API host
variables.description: Address the read-only player-count endpoint binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to allow remote bot access.

variables.name: Player count API port
variables.description: TCP port for the read-only player-count endpoint. Allocate this TCP port on the server.

variables.name: Player count API token
variables.description: Optional bearer token required by the read-only player-count endpoint. Set this when the endpoint is reachable outside a trusted network.

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Where saves, configs, logs and backups live. Internal.

variables.name: Steam directory
variables.description: Holds steamcmd, its Guard sentry and the downloaded game files. Must persist. Internal.

variables.name: Wine prefix
variables.description: Created on first boot inside the volume, since the container does not run as root. Internal.
